import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='xz8lX1K'].copy()
piv = a.pivot_table(index=['cloud_service','application','instance_family'], columns='date', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
prev = piv[piv.columns[:-1]].mean(axis=1); sd = piv[piv.columns[:-1]].std(axis=1)
z = (piv[piv.columns[-1]]-prev)/sd
# print top z for each date
for c in piv.columns:
    prev2 = piv[[x for x in piv.columns if x<c]].tail(7)
    m=prev2.mean(axis=1); s=prev2.std(axis=1).replace(0,1e-9)
    zz=((piv[c]-m)/s).sort_values()
    print(c.date(), zz.tail(3).round(1).to_dict())

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'], format='%m/%d/%y')
a = df[df.account_id=='xz8lX1K'].copy()
piv = a.pivot_table(index=['cloud_service','application','instance_family'], columns='date', values='unblended_cost', aggfunc='sum').fillna(0)
cols=list(piv.columns)
for i in range(7,len(cols)):
    base=piv[cols[i-7:i]]; m=base.mean(axis=1); s=base.std(axis=1).replace(0,float('nan'))
    zz=((piv[cols[i]]-m)/s).dropna().sort_values()
    print(cols[i].date(), [(k, round(v,1)) for k,v in zz.tail(3).items()])

    m=prev2.mean(axis=1); s=prev2.std(axis=1).replace(0,1e-9)

    print(c.date(), zz.tail(3).round(1).to_dict())"}
